matched: Accurate prediction of coagulant dosing is critical to ensure efficiency and cost-effectiveness of water treatment
Development of coagulant dosing prediction model using AutoML for drinking water treatment plants
Application of SHAP method to enhance transparency of AutoML model
AutoML Random Forest model outperformed best single Gradient Boosting Tree model
RF model has potential to save 10.25% coagulant dosage per year with more stable treated water quality
Yangtze River: saves 222 kg/d PACl at cost of 180.7 yuan/d
Luan River: saves 225 kg/d PACl at cost of 183.2 yuan/d
SHAP identified conductivity, ammonia nitrogen, COD, and temperature of raw water as key factors affecting PACl dosage
PACl dosage significantly impacts treated water pH
AutoML and SHAP in intelligent water management bolster efficiency and management with environmental, economic, and social benefits
